mapper.sql: id, container_main_id, ocr_text1, ocr_text2, estimated_quantity, verified_quantity, work_cover_layers, cover_layers, product_layers, content_kind, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO container_data AS new (container_main_id, ocr_text1, ocr_text2, estimated_quantity, verified_quantity, work_cover_layers, cover_layers, product_layers, content_kind) VALUES (#{containerMainId}, #{ocrText1}, #{ocrText2}, #{estimatedQuantity}, #{verifiedQuantity}, #{workCoverLayers}, #{coverLayers}, #{productLayers}, #{contentKind}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ocr_text1 = COALESCE(new.ocr_text1, ocr_text1), ocr_text2 = COALESCE(new.ocr_text2, ocr_text2), estimated_quantity = COALESCE(new.estimated_quantity, estimated_quantity), verified_quantity = COALESCE(new.verified_quantity, verified_quantity), work_cover_layers = COALESCE(new.work_cover_layers, work_cover_layers), cover_layers = COALESCE(new.cover_layers, cover_layers), product_layers = COALESCE(new.product_layers, product_layers), content_kind = IF(content_kind = 'UNKNOWN', COALESCE(new.content_kind, content_kind), content_kind)
